note: the smoke sentence: verb, article-bearing nouns and an accusative noun all front as lemmas
clitic chains mine their lemma; ghadan is a lexicalised tanween adverb
tanween adverbs keep their own lemma (KNOWN MISS: jazilan lemmatises to jazl)
dialect function words are unknown and excluded (KNOWN MISS: arif argmaxes to a proper noun)
Latin words and digits are emitted for span alignment and never mined
a fully vocalised children's line mines unvocalised lemmas; the sentence keeps its tashkeel
hamza-less function words are never mined
broken plurals mine their singular lemma
KNOWN MISS: the imperative has no analysis, so it is unknown and excluded by default
the Arabic question mark is punctuation
normalize folds the lam-alef presentation form and strips tatweel before tokenizing
